name: @evia/deploy-agent
description: Deployment verifier of the VM (EVM-007 AC3, AC4; ADR-0018 V0–V4, V6): reads GitHub (Activity, history, pull requests, runs, the release manifest and the compose file) and decides fail-closed what root may deploy. Runs without a build (Node.js type stripping) in a distroless image pinned by digest in the IaC session.
